findings.namedBuyers: Sam Picken and Jess Picken are each named 2027 conference hosts and C3 Toronto lead pastors; the event biography also identifies them as C3 Canada Regional Directors and C3 Global Executive Team members. They are commercially relevant senior relationship sponsors and referral routes, not verified hotel buyers. Neither has published housing/procurement authority in the reviewed sources. No named conference operations or housing manager was verified. The official general contact route is contact@c3toronto.com.
findings.futureEdition: Official organizer ticketing publishes June 16, 2027 at 7:00 p.m. through June 18, 2027 at 9:00 p.m. EDT. Description repeats “ASSEMBLY CONFERENCE: RUN June 16–18, 2027 Metro Toronto Convention Centre.” These are event activity dates, within the requested horizon. C3 Toronto also promotes the three-day RUN event. The separately promoted September 2027 C3 Global Conference in Sydney is not this edition. No Toronto 2028 edition was established in the reviewed official sources.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: a downtown MTCC event is geographically suitable for Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown; a resort proposition is not supported. A limited speaker, worship-team, visiting church delegation or VIP lodging allocation is more credible than replacing the main event venue. The supplied 157-room inventory and approximately 240-theatre largest room do not support assuming an exclusive whole-conference solution. A roughly 15–109 peak-room sales allocation could be explored only as a hotel-side scenario, not a demand forecast. Event attendance, out-of-town share, room nights and peak rooms are unpublished, so the event cannot yet be classified as too large or too small for the hotel. Side meetings may be considered after needs verification; no catering, restaurant or lounge availability is assumed.
findings.venueCommitments: Published 2027 venue: Metro Toronto Convention Centre, 255 Front St W, Toronto, Ontario M5V 2W6, Canada. This is downtown Toronto proper and inside the hotel’s MTCC demand territory, not a resort or suburban venue. This is an organizer-announced venue commitment, not evidence of an inspected signed venue contract. Exact hall/rooms and North/South building allocation are not published in the organizer listing. Prefer its 255 Front St W address over third-party listings using the South Building address.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified timeline: September 25–27, 2025, Fresh Oil / C3 Toronto conference, main conference at 12 Pauline Avenue, Toronto, with children/youth programming at 20 Pauline Avenue and 322 Geary Avenue; June 3–5, 2026, C3 Assembly Conference at Metro Toronto Convention Centre; June 16–18, 2027, RUN at the same convention centre. This supports recurrence and a local venue change, not an established multi-city destination rotation or fixed annual date pattern. Earlier editions remain unverified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027: unknown. No edition-specific housing bureau, host hotel, room block, booking code, hotel rate, open RFP or hotel contracting contact was found on the reviewed official event pages. Absence of a published block does not establish availability. Historical 2026 precedent: the official conference site lists exactly two hotels: Toronto Marriott City Centre Hotel, One Blue Jays Way, “Special conference rate: $409.00/night”; and InterContinental Toronto Centre, 225 Front St W, “Special conference rate: $429/night”. Currency is not explicitly labeled in those quotes. These are edition-specific advertised rates, not evidence of contracted room quantities, exclusivity, actual pickup, or continuing 2027 commitments. Do not quote them as 2027 rates.
findings.organizationStructure: The organizer account is C3 Assembly; C3 Toronto promotes the event and supplies its lead-pastor hosts. This is a church/movement-led religious gathering, not a professional trade association congress or a corporate incentive. C3 Toronto describes itself as part of C3 Church Global. Metro Toronto Convention Centre is the venue; Humanitix is the ticketing channel, not an identified housing buyer. No PCO, DMC or housing agency was identified; the precise legal contracting entity remains unverified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Historical competitors are Toronto Marriott City Centre Hotel and InterContinental Toronto Centre, both promoted with 2026 conference rates. The 2026 page describes Marriott as a five-minute walk to the convention centre and InterContinental as connected via PATH. This establishes historical competitive positioning, not 2027 incumbency or sold-out conditions. No sourced overflow, compression, hotel-capacity shortfall, exclusive housing agreement or residual inventory was found. MTCC is not itself a competing hotel.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact contact@c3toronto.com referencing RUN, June 16–18, 2027 at MTCC. Request an introduction to the conference operations/housing decision-maker; use Sam and Jess Picken as named leadership references, not presumed signatories. First establish the legal buyer, any agency, 2027 contracted hotels/exclusivity, remaining lodging requirements, arrival/departure nights, out-of-town delegates, peak rooms, rooming-list/payment model and decision deadline. Only then offer a right-sized lodging proposal within hotel availability and credit terms; do not lead with catering. If fully committed, request the next edition’s hotel-review timetable. Final qualification remains with ORS.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, registration is publicly promoted and the main venue is already announced. Hotel-supplier access is unconfirmed: public registration does not mean accommodation sourcing is open. Neither a 2027 commitment elsewhere nor an available Radisson block has been established. Retain as a conditional lodging inquiry, not a confirmed sales-ready RFP.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: consecutive 2025–2027 Toronto editions and the 2026 advertised hotel rates justify relationship development around lodging for future cycles. They do not prove a 2028 edition, future destination choice, a hotel tender cycle or an opportunity to displace a contracted supplier. If 2027 hotels are already selected, ask permission to discuss supplemental allocation and the next sourcing cycle rather than treating the historical hotel list as open business.
